_comment: Hand-authored. Object helpers in bank 7 $FA5B-$FCE6, explained routine by routine. The generator for 20-traced.json subtracts these.

regions.name: Find a free enemy slot
regions.description: Entered through the jump-table slot $C108. Scans slots 5 to 23 for a type of 0 and returns the index in Y with carry clear, or carry set when all 19 are in use. Everything that spawns anything dynamic (explosions, sparks, the formation spawner, the script interpreter's spawns, blasts) goes through this or its sibling $EA8C, which can also reuse some occupied slots.

regions.name: Pixel position to nametable address
regions.description: Entered through the slot $C111. In: $19 = x, $18 = y (already adjusted for the scroll by the caller). Out: $19:$18 = the PPU address of the 8 x 8 tile that holds the point, $2000 + 32 x (y / 8) + x / 8 (high byte $20 + y / 64, low byte (y AND $F8) x 4 | x / 8), and Y = the matching attribute-table offset, $C0 | (y AND $E0) / 4 | x / 32 (the low byte of $23C0 + ...). The block-break routine at $FA96 passes it a point already rounded to a 16 x 16 cell.

regions.name: Break a block: blast, redraw, new cell class
regions.description: Entered through the slot $C117; callers are the weapon-hits-cell code (bank 6 $854B), the boss/stage routine (bank 3 $92B2, $9336) and bank 1 $8159. In: $19 = x, $18 = y of a point in the cell, $16 = the tile argument for the redraw, $15 = the cell's NEW class. It (1) allocates an object through $FA5B and makes it a type-$30 blast at the cell's centre ($19 AND $F0 | 8, $18 AND $F0 | 7); (2) adds the vertical scroll $A6 to y (wrapping at $F0), converts to a PPU address ($FA6B) and queues the new tiles through $D865 with $16; (3) restores $18/$19 and falls into the class write below. If no slot is free the blast is skipped (the BCS at $FA99 goes to $FAB7) but the tiles are still queued and the class still written. RUN on the labyrinth savestate with ($18, $19) = (100, 140) and $15 = 7: a type-$30 blast appeared at y 103, x 136, nine bytes were queued for the PPU, $18/$19 came back unchanged and the cell's class went 0 -> 7 without touching its neighbours. $FADE-$FB11, the class write, is also the jump-table slot $C11D on its own: in the labyrinth only (it does nothing when $30 bit 6 is set, a corridor, run) it stores $15 into the nibble of the class map $0400 for the cell at ($18, $19): index = (y AND $F0) / 2 | x / 32, and bit 4 of x chooses the low nibble (set) or the high one (clear).

regions.name: One explosion at a random point in a box
regions.description: Entered through the slot $C120; callers are bank 1 $80D0 (the boss-death barrage) and bank 2 $88EF (the planet cutscene). Allocates a slot ($FA5B; carry set if none), makes it a type-$08 explosion with $0740 = 0, and places it near ($19 = x, $18 = y) jittered by the box size ($15 wide, $14 high) using the random routine $F9D1, then plays sound $22 ($D852). RUN 300 times with $14 = 32, $15 = 48 at (y 100, x 128): one object per call, y 83-116, x 104-136, so the spread is about half the box size each way in y but skewed in x (the x offset comes from a rotated copy of the same random byte). Read from the code, not from a hardware picture.

regions.name: Negate the y velocity
regions.description: Slot $C126. 0 - ($05D8,X:$05C0,X): the 16-bit y velocity of the calling object (whole byte $05D8, fraction $05C0) is negated, i.e. the object bounces vertically. Callers: types $52 and $59 (bank 6 $A7EB, $B102). Read, not run.

regions.name: Negate the x velocity
regions.description: Slot $C123. 0 - ($0608,X:$05F0,X): the 16-bit x velocity of the calling object is negated, a horizontal bounce. Callers: types $5A and $52 (bank 6 $A5B7, $A7E8). Read, not run.

regions.name: A beam's head and tail: following its parent
regions.description: Slot $C129 (the first half). Called every frame by the Hyper Laser's run routine (weapon 9, bank 6 $8AC4) and by enemy type $22 (bank 6 $A0B8). Reads: $0668,X is the slot of a parent object and $0680,X the type that parent must keep (otherwise it returns with carry set and the caller ends the beam); $0788,X is a phase counter (the parent's x is copied into $0530,X while $0788 is below $0620,X; $0788 is set to 2 at $FBA8 and incremented at $FBC5 and $FBE4); the head is $0518,X, tested against the y velocity ($05D8,X) through $FCC3/$FCCD (beyond $D0 means off the top); $0758,X is the other end of the beam, written at $FBF7 and read by the drawing half. The branches that choose between growing, holding and ending were not worked through, so this region is a LEAD; the drawing half below was run.

regions.name: A beam: a column of sprites, and its hit box
regions.description: The second half of slot $C129. Draws a vertical chain between the object's two y ends ($0518,X and $0758,X) in steps of 16 pixels, one piece per step: the object's metasprite $0548,X through $CC34, or, when that is 0, single sprites through $CF05, at x $0530,X with attributes $0560,X and base tile $06C8,X. It then sets the collision box that $D348 reads: x from $0530 - $0650 to $0530 + $0650 (clamped to 0 and 255) into $06E0/$06F8, and y from the smaller end to the larger + 15 into $0710/$0728. $0650,X is the beam's half-width. RUN as the Hyper Laser (weapon 9) from the corridor savestate: the routine was entered once per frame while the beam lived; the box half-widths were 3, 8 and 24 pixels (widths 6, 16, 48) at levels 1, 2 and 3 and the y extent ran from the beam's head (y 128 -> 68 as it rose at level 1) to a second end (147 at level 1, 191 at levels 2 and 3 in the frames sampled); level 1 drew single sprites (at x - 4), levels 2 and 3 metasprites 26 and 23.

regions.name: Beam helpers: y plus velocity, and a +/-16 wrap
regions.description: $FCC3: A + the y velocity's whole byte ($05D8,X), compared with $D0; returns Y = that velocity (carry set = beyond $D0). $FCCD (entered with the flags $FCC3 left, so N = the velocity's sign): a positive velocity subtracts 16 (SBC #$10), a negative one adds 15 plus carry ($FCD2, ADC #$0F): moves a beam end by one 16-pixel piece against the direction it travels. Called only from the beam routine.

regions.name: Move with the scroll
regions.description: Slot $C12C. In a corridor ($30 bit 6) adds the scroll step $B7 (whole pixels moved this frame) to the object's y $0518,X, so the object stays fixed on the background; returns carry set when the result passes $D0 (off the bottom). In the labyrinth it does nothing. Callers: the pickup box (bank 2 $8543) and ground types $16, $63 and $7A (bank 6 $8C24, $AFF4, $BA56, $BA5E). Read, not run.
